biotools.summary: AutScore is an integrative prioritization algorithm developed to identify clinically relevant autism spectrum disorder candidate variants from whole-exome sequencing data. It assigns variants based on pathogenicity, clinical relevance, gene-disease association, and inheritance patterns.
